title: High Value Cash Payments
policy_text: Cash payments equal to or above USD 5,000,000 require enhanced due diligence and manual review.

title: High Risk Jurisdiction
policy_text: Transfers to jurisdictions with country risk score 4 or 5 require additional source-of-funds verification.

title: Behavior Deviation
policy_text: Transactions exceeding 10x a customer monthly average should be investigated for unusual activity.

title: New Destination
policy_text: First-time destination country for a customer should be combined with transaction amount and KYC risk before decision.

title: Large Crypto Transfer
policy_text: Crypto transfers above USD 250,000 require wallet review and sanctions screening.

title: Opaque Merchant
policy_text: Large payments to consulting, charity, or unknown categories require invoice and beneficial owner review.

title: Prior SAR Customer
policy_text: Customers with prior SAR activity require lower escalation thresholds.

title: HNI Advisor Payment
policy_text: HNI advisor-initiated payments above USD 1,000,000 require advisor confirmation and purpose validation.

title: Rapid Movement
policy_text: Multiple large transactions within 24 hours can indicate layering activity.

title: Cross Border Wires
policy_text: Cross-border wires over USD 500,000 should be checked against customer expected activity.
